aboutpara: I work at the Central Bank of Ireland on ECB policy, covering monetary policy operational framework, payments infrastructure, and collateral frameworks. Previously I supervised fund depositaries holding over $2tn in assets, leading engagement with C-suite executives on capital adequacy, operational resilience, and governance risk. I build tools and automation to enhance analytical workflows, and I'm focused on bridging policy analysis with quantitative investment research.

resume.description: Senior Policy Associate at the Central Bank of Ireland with experience spanning ECB monetary policy, funds supervision, and enforcement. CFA Level 1 passed. Building toward investment analysis and macro-policy research.
